beginner.title: Get started with D3.js
beginner.outcome: You can: set up D3.js, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Load and explore data
beginner.outcome: You can: open data and get first answers
beginner.practice: Load a dataset and answer three questions

beginner.title: First charts
beginner.outcome: You can: make clear, honest charts
beginner.practice: Make three charts that each answer one question

intermediate.title: Analysis that holds up
intermediate.outcome: You can: analyse correctly and reproducibly
intermediate.practice: Reproduce an analysis from start to finish

intermediate.title: Share and publish
intermediate.outcome: You can: share results with decision-makers
intermediate.practice: Publish a report for a colleague

intermediate.title: Signature skills in D3.js
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make D3.js distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced D3.js
expert.outcome: You can: use D3.js's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Automate and govern
expert.outcome: You can: run analysis reliably over time
expert.practice: Schedule a refresh and document metric definitions

expert.title: Integrate D3.js into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect D3.js with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect D3.js to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use D3.js well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use D3.js" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
